quick.productName: TRAILHEAD CRUNCH Barra de Miel y Cacahuate

analysis.summary: This is a honey and peanut snack bar. It is not safe for you: peanuts are a main ingredient, and it may also have tree nuts. It also contains honey, which is not vegan.

personalFlags.title: Contains peanuts
personalFlags.explanation: Peanuts are listed as an ingredient and in the allergen statement. This matches your peanut allergy.

personalFlags.title: May contain tree nuts
personalFlags.explanation: The label says it may contain nuts and is made in a plant that also processes them. This is a cross-contact risk for your tree nut allergy.
personalFlags.evidence: Puede contener nueces, leche, trigo y ajonjolí.

personalFlags.title: Honey is not vegan
personalFlags.explanation: Honey comes from bees, so it conflicts with a vegan diet.

personalFlags.title: May contain milk
personalFlags.explanation: The label says it may contain milk from cross-contact. This could matter for a vegan diet. Check with the maker if unsure.
personalFlags.evidence: Puede contener nueces, leche, trigo y ajonjolí.

personalFlags.title: Natural flavor source unclear
personalFlags.explanation: Natural flavor can come from plant or animal sources. The label does not say which. Check with the maker.

labelWarnings.text: Made in a plant that also processes nuts, milk, wheat and sesame.
labelWarnings.evidence: Elaborado en una planta que también procesa estos alérgenos.

keyFacts.label: Storage
keyFacts.value: Consérvese en un lugar fresco y seco

analysis.disclaimer: If you have a severe allergy, avoid this product and ask a doctor or pharmacist if you are unsure.
